social_security.summary: South Dakota has no state personal income tax, so Social Security benefits are not taxed by the state.

notes: South Dakota levies no personal income tax of any kind; no statute section is quoted because there is no income tax statute to cite. Retirees still pay sales and use tax and property tax.
